static_findings.snippet: Python projects use **uv workspaces** (similar to pnpm workspaces for JS) with manual `project.json`
**Key Insight**: uv manages Python deps via workspace, Nx orchestrates tasks. Single `uv.lock` at ro
| Run all tests | `pnpm nx run-many -t test` |
| Generate JS/TS app | `pnpm nx g @nx/next:app name` |
| Generate JS/TS lib | `pnpm nx g @nx/js:lib name` |
| Init Python project | `cd apps/name && uv init` |

content.user_title: Manage Nx Monorepos with AI Assistance
content.value_statement: Large monorepos are hard to analyze, generate, and validate consistently. This skill gives AI assistants practical Nx workflows for graphs, affected tasks, generators, caching, and team coordination.
actual_capabilities: Explains Nx CLI workflows for project graphs, affected detection, and task execution.
Shows setup patterns for JavaScript, TypeScript, and Python uv workspace projects.
Provides example nx.json and project.json configuration patterns.
Covers local cache, Nx Cloud, and affected-only CI pipeline examples.
Includes reference guidance for ownership, PR stacking, and code review workflows.
limitations: It does not run Nx MCP tools by itself.
Command examples can modify workspaces and should be reviewed before execution.
It assumes Nx, pnpm, and uv are installed where relevant.
It does not replace project-specific architecture or security review.

use_cases.title: Audit Workspace Impact
use_cases.description: Identify affected projects, dependency edges, and target commands before a change lands.

use_cases.title: Generate New Projects
use_cases.description: Create repeatable app and library plans using Nx generators and workspace conventions.

use_cases.title: Improve CI Performance
use_cases.description: Tune cacheable targets, affected-only pipelines, and Nx Cloud adoption steps.

prompt_templates.title: Understand My Workspace
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this Nx workspace structure. Explain the main projects, likely dependencies, and the safest commands to inspect the graph.

prompt_templates.title: Plan an Affected Build
prompt_templates.prompt: Given these changed files, identify likely affected projects and propose the Nx affected commands I should run before opening a PR.

prompt_templates.title: Add an Application
prompt_templates.prompt: Plan a new application in this Nx monorepo. Include generator choice, directory, cache settings, verification steps, and review risks.

prompt_templates.title: Optimize Monorepo CI
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze this Nx CI workflow. Recommend changes for affected-only execution, caching, parallelism, and safer rollout across teams.

output_examples.input: Which projects should I test after changing a shared library?
output_examples.output: A dependency-focused summary lists direct consumers, likely transitive consumers, and a validation plan using affected project checks.

output_examples.input: How should I add a Python service to this Nx workspace?
output_examples.output: A concise implementation plan covers directory creation, uv workspace membership, Nx target definitions, and verification steps.

output_examples.input: Why is our CI running too many monorepo tasks?
output_examples.output: A CI review highlights missing affected filters, cache gaps, unstable inputs, and a staged rollout plan for faster builds.

best_practices: Run dry-run generation steps before modifying large workspaces.
Use affected commands to limit builds, tests, and lint checks to relevant projects.
Keep ownership, cache inputs, and CI rules aligned with project boundaries.
anti_patterns: Do not run broad monorepo tasks when affected detection is enough.
Do not add projects without updating workspace membership and ownership records.
Do not treat generated configuration as final without project-specific review.

faq.question: Does this skill execute Nx commands automatically?
faq.answer: No. It provides guidance and examples for an assistant or user to review before running commands.

faq.question: Which project types does it cover?
faq.answer: It covers common JavaScript, TypeScript, React, Next.js, Node, and Python uv workspace patterns.

faq.question: Can it help with Nx Cloud?
faq.answer: Yes. It explains connection, remote cache checks, and CI usage patterns for Nx Cloud.

faq.question: Can it replace Nx documentation?
faq.answer: No. It organizes common workflows and recommends using Nx documentation tools for current details.

faq.question: Is it useful for non-Nx monorepos?
faq.answer: Only partially. The guidance is designed around Nx project graphs, targets, caching, and generators.

faq.question: What should I verify before using generated plans?
faq.answer: Check package manager choice, project naming rules, ownership boundaries, and CI requirements for your repository.
